text:
maria: Heads-up — Tideway is evaluating a full swap from TuringX to Redwood. They want a short POC to validate parity on ~3 endpoints, plus answers for pricing and security. Can we scope blockers?
eli: Good news — parity is doable but expect surface-level deltas: tokenization, default stop sequences, and a couple prompt-formatting quirks. We should do a small adapter shim in the POC.
priya: For pricing: we need to show token mapping and a model of expected unit cost vs their current provider. Tideway currently bills per 1k tokens + per-request multiplier for transforms. We'll run a 72-hour smoke with sample traffic to estimate.
sarah: Security checklist — Tideway is enterprise, SOC2 + SSO + KMS are mandatory. Also they asked about egress IPs and audit logs. I can prepare the security questionnaire answers but need confirmation on KMS flow for Private deployments.
maria: Do we have a runbook for the shim and prompt parity tests? Also legal wants a list of any customer-impacting incompatibilities up front.
eli: Quick plan: 1) lightweight proxy that maps TuringX headers to Redwood API; 2) prompt normalization layer for stop tokens + temperature defaults; 3) smoke tests: exact-match on seed prompts + fuzzy eval on 50 golden prompts. I can share a minimal proxy snippet: ```bash
# example proxy mapping
curl -X POST https://redwood.internal/proxy 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDFOO' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rtm","input": "$INPUT"}'
```
maria: Perfect. Timeline? Tideway wants to demo next Wed (10 business days). Are we blocked by security review?
sarah: I'll need to run QuickSec: SOC2 artifacts, KMS integration diagram, and IP allowlist for their firewall. If they need HSM-backed keys for Private, that'll add 2 weeks. For Hosted + dedicated routing it's just IPs + SSO metadata.
priya: Pricing options to present: A) Hosted pay-as-you-go (simple, higher unit cost) B) Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit, predictable cost, better latency) C) Hybrid with burst on hosted. I will model costs for their 3 canonical workloads and include break-even points.
eli: On response diffs — we should capture deterministic baseline: seed prompts with `max_tokens`, `temperature=0`, `stop` set. Differences usually show in tokenization and how we treat trailing whitespace in structured outputs. We'll include a small fuzz score and token-count delta.
maria: Customer asked about VPC/private data flow. Can someone confirm network diagram and whether audit logs will show request-level metadata?
sarah: Yes, Private gives audit logs with request_id, model_version, token counts. Hosted provides aggregated logs and per-request tracing if they opt into retention add-on. I'll attach a sample questionnaire answer in the follow-up.
eli: Ops can provision a POC space. I'll need: list of sample prompts (50), a seed corpus (jsonl), and the IPs for their firewall. I can run the canary and grab traces.
ops-bot: POC env created: redwood-poc-tideway-171500 created. Access expires in 21 days.
maria: Great — Eli, can you take point on the proxy + smoke tests? Sarah, can you own the questionnaire answers and KMS note? Priya, pricing model and a simple one-page SOW draft?
eli: On it. I'll push the proxy to the POC env and post a runbook.
sarah: I'll draft answers today and flag any HSM requirements.
priya: I'll have the pricing deck and breakeven table by Friday.
maria: OK scheduling note: let's demo to Tideway next Wednesday 16:00 PT. I'll book calendar and include Tideway sec + infra. Can we have a pre-demo dry run on Tuesday?
eli: Tuesday dry run works. I'll prepare the delta report and a short doc with remediation notes for any non-parity items.
maria: Thanks. One more ask from legal: will the shim change any data residency guarantees? We need a line for the contract.
sarah: The shim runs in-customer-region POC env and doesn't persist prompts outside the configured storage. I'll include a short statement and sample config: `data_retention: off` for the POC.
maria: Awesome. If anything blocks the Wednesday demo, call it out here by EOD Monday. :thumbsup:
eli: Will do.
ops-bot: Reminder: POC logs retention set to 7 days by default, can be extended on request.
maria: Closing checklist: pre-demo runbook, security questionnaire, pricing sheet, proxy + smoke results. Thanks team.
eli: I'll upload smoke results and the proxy link to the POC env.
sarah: Questionnaire draft in channel by EOD.
priya: Pricing model uploaded to shared drive (link shared in DM).
